propositions: Standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder needs to accumulate firing history and compute detection/blocking-FP proxies without outcome-corpus git-walk or marginal LLM cost

Recorder appends one lean firing row per (review-round, finding) to append-only ledger criterion_firings.jsonl, auto-including every criterion id seen, with dedup key (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id)

Report computes detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction later de-escalated/dropped and never remediated) per criterion over trailing window
Recorder is idempotent and prune-immune: re-running --backfill produces no duplicates, and ledger captures firings before sidecar 50-round retention prune
Metrics artifact runs/criterion_effectiveness.json is committed and CI-visible; firing ledger is git-ignored as regenerable local standing artifact (analogous to .tickets-tracker/)

All 7 acceptance criteria demonstrated: >5000-row ledger with >=30 criteria, deterministic pure functions tested, committed metrics show non-null proxies, zero LLM calls, landed via Gerrit change #798 with CI gates green
